svg.title: Masonry: elevation
svg.desc: Elevation comparing three kinds of masonry: ashlar of squared, dressed stone in regular courses; rubble of rough, irregular stones; and brick in Flemish bond, with headers (ends) and stretchers (sides) alternating in each course. Source: Original drawing by Project Exodus from the standard geometric construction of this form; no external drawing reproduced.

g.text: WALLS BUILT OF STONE OR BRICK UNITS LAID IN MORTAR
